Ron Meinhardt

Independent candidate for United States Senator, Oklahoma · Open seat

Registered nurse and finance manager/CFO

Ron Meinhardt is a registered nurse and finance manager from Nowata County, Oklahoma, and is running as an Independent for U.S. Senate in the November 3, 2026 special election. He says he is currently a member of the Oklahoma Republican Party and is running as an Independent to give voters a grassroots conservative option. The State Election Board's candidate list includes him on the general election ballot, according to News On 6.

Where Meinhardt stands

Alignment with President Trump
Says no president, Republican or Democrat, should take the U.S. into an open-ended war without a vote of Congress. Says voters do not owe blind loyalty to party-boss endorsements.
Cost of living / economy
Lists making living costs and energy bills more affordable as a priority. Says he wants to lower the cost of living and give younger generations something better than debt and inflation.
Health care
Lists making health care more affordable as a priority. Says his experience in health care led him to run for office.
Defense / military
Opposes 'forever' wars and says Congress must authorize war. Calls for strict adherence to the War Powers Resolution of 1973.
Immigration
Supports enforcing immigration laws while 'radically improving them.' Says immigration policy should come from clear laws passed by Congress, not executive action or selective enforcement.
Government transparency
Lists increased government transparency as a campaign priority.
Inola aluminum smelter
Opposes the proposed Inola aluminum smelter and says he advocates for Oklahoma farmers and ranchers.

Background

  • Bachelor's degree (BSN), Columbia Union College, 2005
  • Registered nurse
  • Former chief financial officer; manager of finance and administration at Rota-Tech, Inc. (2023–present, per a third-party profile)
  • Executive producer, Entering Wedge Media (2019–present, per a third-party profile)
  • Graduate student in public policy at Liberty University
  • No prior elected office found
